To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed a novel type of microfluidic labchip for on site diagnosis of Cronobacter and demonstrated that the chip can detect the minimum recoverable levels in PIF without post enrichment treatment.
the present study presents an innovative approach to overcome the limitations of conventional microfluidic technology by the development of a thermocycler and a novel type of microfluidic labchip.
a new labchip based thermocycler was developed and the minimum recoverable Cronobacters level of 1 CFU per 300g PIF was achieved by direct detection without post enrichment procedures.

the development of a novel microfluidic chip based diagnosis system for the sensitive and easy to implement on site application of single recoverable pathogens without post enrichment treatment in PIF.

the development of a novel labchip and thermocyler specialized for the gene detection in microfluidic devices and the evaluation of its detection performance by the detection of the minimum recoverable levels of Cronobacter species in powdered infant formulas.
the development of a novel type of microfluidic chip for the detection of food borne pathogens.

the developed system can be used for on site diagnosis of single recoverable C. sakazakii in PIF.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the present study is the first report to describe the application of a microfluidic chip and thermocycling device for the detection of single recoverables of Cronobacter without the use of enrichment broth and post enrichment procedures.

the present study has developed a novel type of thermocycler for microfluidic labchip with a simplified protocol for the detection of foodborne pathogens in a single chip without post enrichment steps.
this study has demonstrated the potential of microfluidic labchip based diagnosis system to be a powerful tool for the on site diagnosis of foodborne pathogen.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the developed system is able to detect the presence of single recoverable cells of target organisms in PIF samples without post enrichment processing and the detection of single recoverables in PIF samples was achieved by the simple protocol of direct loading of samples into the chip.
the novel labchip based detection system can be applied for on site diagnosis of Cronobacter contamination in PIF and the results can be obtained within 12 h of sample preparation.
the developed labchip system is a powerful tool for the detection of foodborne pathogens in PIF.
